body_policy: Clearly human-shaped ceremonial effigies: attached head/neck, ribcage, waist, pelvis, two arms, two long legs. Stage identity through shell/device/pose, not replacing body with giant objects.
reference_policy: Actual Part I PNGs submitted as initial generation references. Original Stage02 effigy was visually reviewed for human proportions only, not supplied to these calls. v2/v3 images not used.
